A fix so the Claude plugin directory can read desk-look again; nothing changes on screen.

- A local name in the spinner and the band above the prompt shadowed the function that draws the `◇ Plan` card, so the directory check could not tell which function received the hook's `$` and blocked the release. The local name is renamed

## Install

```
/plugin install desk-look --marketplace KyongSik-Yoon/cc-desktop-mod
```

Already installed: `/desk-update` (or `claude plugin update desk-look`), then `/reload-plugins`.
